requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-5361-5929--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Auton Soldier. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

141-5100-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5100-5686.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3277-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
3277-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
3277-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Izzet Chronarch and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-6026--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-6026--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2757-3525-7734.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Wakandan Tusker.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

141-2921-3125.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
141-2921-3125.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Naru Meha and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-4359.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-4359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-2525-3763-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2034-2525-3763-6749.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Body Double from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Body Double enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Body Double enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

372-4863-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4863-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Revolutionist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Revolutionist trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Revolutionist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

628-3698-7189.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Dread Tiller trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1318-2743-7063.description:
Cast Ember Island Production by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Ember Island Production twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Ember Island Production spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

4311-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3681-6714.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block the creature that has Super State and Grafted Exoskeleton attached.
3681-6714.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Super State and Grafted Exoskeleton attached, causing the opponent it was attacking to get at least eleven poison counters. The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Super State triggers, causing the creature to cause each opponent to get at least eleven poison counters. The opponents lose the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

864-4067-5116-6281.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Eternal Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Eternal Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

3487-4364-4636-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Aurelia that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the oldest Aurelia into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aurelia token enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Declare the Aurelia token as an attacker. The token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

710-2961-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Danitha, adding {R}.
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

1479-3756-3908.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

3401-5517-5803.manaNeeded: {11}{U}{U} minus {1} for each other artifact you control
3401-5517-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater, has at least one +1/+1 counter on it, and does not have summoning sickness.
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3401-5517-5803.description:
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying {12}{U}{U}, minus {1} for each artifact you control.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of mana-producing artifacts you control, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3073-3750-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
3073-3750-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers twice, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 6 life.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

851-1737-4404-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Corridor Monitor.
The Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, untapping Prototype Portal and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

1358-3525-5116.notablePrerequisites: Gilded Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
1358-3525-5116.description:
Activate Sydri by paying {U}, causing Gilded Lotus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

1702-3212-3258.description:
Activate Jace's zero loyalty ability, putting Beacon of Tomorrows on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Beacon of Tomorrows, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {4}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.
